children: LightPath Technologies Inc reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $71.7M, up 93% from $37.2M a year earlier, while the company posted a net loss of $20.5M for FY2026 and diluted loss per share of $(0.38), compared with a net loss of $14.9M and diluted loss per share of $(0.36) in FY2025.
Revenue was $71.7M, compared with $37.2M in the prior year; YoY change 93%.
Net income was $(20.5M), compared with $(14.9M) in the prior year; YoY change (37.6%).
Diluted EPS was $(0.38), compared with $(0.36) in the prior year; YoY change (5.6%).

Revenue growth was driven by strong demand in assemblies/modules and infrared components; assemblies and modules rose to 44% of revenue from 23% the prior year, supporting higher-margin camera/module sales.
Company won large programs with a global technology customer and secured defense and security contracts, expanding backlog to $110.9M.
Management increased capital expenditures and tooling for glass fabrication, coatings and metrology to support the backlog and production of BD6/BDNL materials.
Continued R&D investments and development of proprietary materials (BlackDiamond/AMTIR) aimed at mitigating germanium supply risks.
Net loss widened primarily due to a $14.1M increase in fair-value acquisition earnouts, which materially affected FY2026 results.
